name: Universe
description: Sealed, disposable Docker sandboxes for AI agents: no network, no access to your machine.

agentTools.instructions: Universe gives you sealed, disposable Docker sandboxes ("universes") to write and run code in. A universe has NO network access and NO access to the host machine: you cannot reach the internet, the user's files or other services, so installs (pip install, npm install, apt-get, git clone of a remote) will fail. Use what the image already ships (Python 3 with pytest/numpy/pandas, Node + npm, Go, git, build-essential, ripgrep, jq). Typical flow: universe_create (use from_project to copy the open project in, minus secrets and build output) -> universe_write_file / universe_exec -> if universe_exec returns a job_id, poll universe_job until it finishes -> read results with universe_read_file -> universe_destroy when done. Everything lives under /workspace; the rest of the filesystem is read-only apart from /tmp. Only the user can copy files out of a universe to the host.

tools.name: universe_create
tools.description: Create a new sealed sandbox container (no network, non-root, resource-limited) with an empty /workspace. With from_project=true the user's open project folder is copied in, skipping node_modules, .git, .env files, secrets and build/cache dirs. Returns what was created and what was skipped.

name.description: Universe name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes; max 30 chars)

from_project.description: Copy the current project folder into /workspace (default false)

tools.name: universe_list
tools.description: List existing universes with status, age and approximate workspace size.

tools.name: universe_write_file
tools.description: Write a text file inside a universe's /workspace (parent folders are created). Max 64 KB per call; set append=true to build larger files in chunks.

name.description: Universe name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes; max 30 chars)

path.description: File path, relative to /workspace (or absolute under /workspace)

tools.name: universe_read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from a universe's /workspace. Large files are truncated (the reply says so).

name.description: Universe name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes; max 30 chars)

tools.name: universe_list_files
tools.description: List files and folders (two levels deep) under a path in a universe's /workspace.

name.description: Universe name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes; max 30 chars)

tools.name: universe_exec
tools.description: Run a shell command (sh -lc, in /workspace, as a non-root user, no network) inside a universe. Waits up to about 40s: if the command finishes, returns the exit code and output (stdout and stderr merged, truncated). If still running it keeps running in the background and returns a job_id to poll with universe_job.

name.description: Universe name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes; max 30 chars)

tools.name: universe_job
tools.description: Check a background job started by universe_exec: running or finished, the exit code once finished, and the new output since the last poll. Optionally waits up to wait_seconds for it to finish.

name.description: Universe name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes; max 30 chars)

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the job to finish (0-40, default 0)

tools.name: universe_destroy
tools.description: Permanently delete a universe: its container and its /workspace volume. Do this when you are done.

name.description: Universe name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes; max 30 chars)
